forkLineage.title: Project Lineage & Forks
forkLineage.description: S2B2S is built upon a chain of open-source projects that each contributed essential features
forkLineage.details:
Handy (github.com/cjpais/Handy) — original STT desktop app skeleton, MIT
AIVORelay (github.com/MaxITService/AIVORelay) — streaming STT, profiles, RNNoise, browser relay, MIT
Parler (github.com/Melvynx/Parler) — Gemini STT, long-audio routing, crash logging, MIT
Parrot (github.com/cjpais/parrot) — Kokoro worker pool, crossfade, markdown sanitization, MIT
CopySpeak (github.com/yourfriendoss/copyspeak) — TTS read-aloud, warm-engine lifecycle, double-copy, MIT
Vox (github.com/mrtozner/vox) — voice-over-WebSocket protocol reference
Parakeet-Realtime-Transcriber — streaming STT parameter reference
TranscriptionSuite — persist-before-deliver, LAN GPU concept, GPL-3.0
Whispering — provider matrix, transformations concept, AGPL-3.0

Thank you to every contributor across this lineage for making S2B2S possible.

sttModels.title: Speech-to-Text Models
sttModels.description: Local STT models and inference engines that power transcription
sttModels.details:
Whisper.cpp (github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp) — fast CPU/GPU Whisper inference by Georgi Gerganov
NVIDIA NeMo Parakeet (github.com/NVIDIA/NeMo) — TDT 0.6B V3 STT model, CC-BY-4.0
Silero VAD (github.com/snakers4/silero-vad) — voice activity detection, MIT
Moonshine — streaming STT models by Useful Sensors
Whisper Large V3 / Turbo / Small / Medium — OpenAI Whisper model family
Breeze ASR — Chinese STT model
Canary 180M / 1B — NVIDIA Canary STT
Sense Voice — multilingual STT
Giga AM V3 — NVIDIA Giga AM STT
Cohere — Cohere STT model

Models distributed via blob.handy.computer CDN.

ttsEngines.title: Text-to-Speech Engines
ttsEngines.description: Local and cloud TTS engines that give S2B2S its voice
ttsEngines.details:
Piper (github.com/rhasspy/piper) — fast local neural TTS, 26 English voices, MIT
Kokoro (github.com/hexgrad/kokoro) — 82M ONNX TTS, 54 voices across 9 languages, Apache 2.0
Kitten TTS (github.com/KittenML/KittenTTS) — ultra-lightweight CPU TTS, 8 voices, MIT
Pocket TTS (github.com/kyutai/pocket-tts-without-voice-cloning) — compact VITS TTS with voice cloning, MIT

Cloud TTS: OpenAI TTS, ElevenLabs, Cartesia Sonic

brainLlm.title: Brain & LLM Backend
brainLlm.description: Local and cloud LLM providers that power the conversational Brain

Gemma-4 (Google / unsloth) — default local LLM model, Gemma license

And all other crate authors whose work makes S2B2S possible.

enabled.label: Enable speech output
enabled.description: Allow S2B2S to read text aloud (CopySpeak read-anywhere and spoken Brain replies).

descriptions.piper: Local: Fast, lightweight neural TTS with 20+ English voices. Works fully offline — no account or internet required.
descriptions.kokoro: Local: High-quality offline TTS with natural-sounding voices and broad accent coverage. 54 voices across 9 languages.
descriptions.kitten: Local: Ultra-lightweight TTS (25-80MB) with 8 natural voices. CPU-optimized ONNX inference, no GPU required.
descriptions.pocket: Local: Compact offline TTS engine with 8 distinct character voices. Uses PyTorch/VITS architecture.
descriptions.qwen3: Local: High-quality multilingual offline TTS engine using CUDA Graph capture and In-Context Learning for voice cloning.
descriptions.audio_cpp: Local: Ultra-high-performance native C++ GGML/GGUF runtime. Runs Supertonic 3, Qwen3-TTS, PocketTTS, DotsTTS, and Chatterbox up to 200x real-time on CUDA without Python.
descriptions.sapi: Local: Built-in Windows speech synthesis. Zero download, always available as a fallback.
descriptions.openai: Cloud: High-quality natural voices via the OpenAI API. Requires an API key and internet connection.
descriptions.elevenlabs: Cloud: Premium AI voice synthesis with emotional range, 1000+ voices, and multilingual support.
descriptions.cartesia: Cloud: Low-latency, natural TTS powered by Sonic 3.5. Requires an API key and internet connection.

qwen3Language.description: Language used for synthesis. Auto detects the spoken language from each utterance; dialects (e.g. Sichuan/Beijing Mandarin) apply automatically on supported voices.

audiocppModel.label: Model family
audiocppModel.description: Select the native C++ GGUF audio model family for high-speed local inference.

audiocppBackend.label: Compute Backend
audiocppBackend.description: Hardware acceleration backend used by audio.cpp (CUDA recommended for NVIDIA GPUs).

audiocppManager.groupDescription: Browse, download, manage quantization variants, and select native GGUF speech models.
audiocppManager.noModelsFound: No audio.cpp models match your search.
audiocppManager.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete '{{name}}' from disk?

sanitizeEnabled.label: Clean text before speaking
sanitizeEnabled.description: Apply cleanup passes to text before synthesis.

sanitizeMarkdown.label: Strip markdown
sanitizeMarkdown.description: Remove code blocks, links, headers, lists and quotes.

sanitizeNormalize.label: Normalize for speech
sanitizeNormalize.description: Expand abbreviations, symbols, units and currencies (e.g. $50 becomes 50 dollars).

doubleCopy.label: Double-copy to speak
doubleCopy.description: Copy the same text twice within 1.5 seconds to read it aloud automatically (Windows only for now).

fastFirstSentence.label: Fast first sentence
fastFirstSentence.description: Split the first sentence at a clause boundary and play it immediately while the rest is still being synthesized. Dramatically reduces time-to-first-audio.

playGreetingToggle.label: Play Startup Greeting Audio
playGreetingToggle.description: Speak the warmup sentence aloud when the voice model finishes loading

greetingText.label: Greeting Text
greetingText.description: The greeting text spoken at startup

greetingEngine.label: Greeting Engine
greetingEngine.description: The TTS engine used for the startup greeting

greetingVoice.label: Greeting Voice
greetingVoice.description: The voice used for the startup greeting

greetingSpeed.label: Greeting Speed
greetingSpeed.description: Playback rate for the startup greeting

greetingNoiseWScale.label: Noise W Scale
greetingNoiseWScale.description: Phoneme width variability (Piper HTTP noise_w_scale). 0=precise, 0.8=Piper default.

repeatGreeting.label: Repeat Startup Greeting
repeatGreeting.description: Play the startup greeting message out loud

speech.clonedVoicesHint: Cloned voices appear with 🎙️ prefix in the voice list.

audiocppLanguage.label: Idioma
audiocppLanguage.description: Idioma utilizado para la síntesis de voz (Supertonic admite 31 idiomas, Chatterbox 19 idiomas, OmniVoice 646+ idiomas).

audiocppInstructions.label: Instrucción de Estilo / Emoción
audiocppInstructions.description: Instrucción en lenguaje natural para guiar el tono, la emoción y el estilo de pronunciación.
audiocppInstructions.placeholder: p. ej., susurrando suavemente, enérgico y alegre...

audiocppAdvanced.title: Parámetros de Generación Avanzados
audiocppAdvanced.description: Ajuste la temperatura de muestreo, probabilidad nucleus, penalización de repetición y escala de guía.

audiocppTemperature.label: Temperatura
audiocppTemperature.description: Controla la variación fonética y la expresividad. Valores bajos son más estables; valores altos más expresivos.

audiocppTopP.label: Top-P (Muestreo Nucleus)
audiocppTopP.description: Umbral de masa de probabilidad para el muestreo nucleus.

audiocppTopK.label: Muestreo Top-K
audiocppTopK.description: Restringe el muestreo a los K candidatos más probables (0 para desactivar).

audiocppRepetitionPenalty.label: Penalización de Repetición
audiocppRepetitionPenalty.description: Penaliza la repetición de sílabas para evitar tartamudeos.

audiocppGuidanceScale.label: Escala de Guía / Emoción
audiocppGuidanceScale.description: Fuerza de guía y emoción para modelos de difusión y coincidencia de flujo (p. ej., Chatterbox).

audiocppInferenceSteps.label: Pasos de Inferencia
audiocppInferenceSteps.description: Número de pasos de eliminación de ruido. Más pasos aumentan la fidelidad a costa de latencia.

audiocppSeed.label: Semilla Determinista (Seed)
audiocppSeed.description: Establezca una semilla fija para una síntesis reproducible (-1 para aleatoria).

audiocppHardware.title: Ejecución de Hardware y Cómputo
audiocppHardware.description: Configure la aceleración GPU, los hilos de CPU y los índices de dispositivos.

audiocppThreads.label: Hilos de Inferencia CPU
audiocppThreads.description: Número de hilos utilizados durante la inferencia en CPU.

audiocppDeviceId.label: ID de Dispositivo GPU
audiocppDeviceId.description: Índice de GPU para CUDA / Vulkan en sistemas multi-GPU (predeterminado: 0).

enabled.label: Enable the Brain
enabled.description: Connect speech to a language model: ask by voice, stream the reply, optionally hear it spoken.

baseUrl.label: Endpoint
baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Default is local Ollama; LM Studio uses http://localhost:1234/v1.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.description: Only needed for cloud endpoints; leave empty for local servers.

systemPrompt.label: System prompt
systemPrompt.description: Personality and instructions for the Brain's replies.

warmupPrompt.label: Warmup prompt
warmupPrompt.description: Dummy prompt sent to warm up the model when it loads into VRAM. Leave empty to skip warmup.

contextTurns.label: Memory (turns)
contextTurns.description: How many previous exchanges the Brain remembers. 0 means each question is independent.

compaction.label: Summarize old turns
compaction.description: When the conversation outgrows the context window, compress the oldest turns into a short summary instead of forgetting them. When off, old turns are simply dropped.

tools.label: Built-in tools
tools.description: Allow the Brain to use offline tools (current time, clipboard read/write). Tool calls are validated and executed locally; results are fed back so the assistant can answer with them.

readAloud.label: Read replies aloud
readAloud.description: Speak each reply sentence-by-sentence while it streams (requires speech output).

endpointPreset.label: End of speech sensitivity
endpointPreset.description: How long the Brain waits in silence before deciding you finished speaking in hands-free mode.

headphoneMode.label: Headphone mode
headphoneMode.description: Allow barge-in: speaking interrupts the Brain's reply. Safe with headphones; with speakers the assistant could hear its own voice and interrupt itself.

autoListen.label: Auto-listen after replies
autoListen.description: Resume listening immediately after each reply in hands-free mode. When off, a short grace period prevents capturing room reverb.

replyLanguage.label: Reply language
replyLanguage.description: Language the Brain replies in. "Auto" mirrors the language you speak. Choose a specific language to always reply in it.

speakableOutputPrompt.label: Speakable output prompt
speakableOutputPrompt.description: Extra instructions appended when replies are read aloud — keeps answers conversational and free of markdown.

engineStatus.title: Engine Status
engineStatus.description: Status and properties of the active local llama.cpp server.

audioInput.label: Audio Input (Default: On)
audioInput.description: Sends the raw WAV recording alongside text to the Brain model. Gemma 4 processes the audio natively for enhanced transcription accuracy. Enabled by default for the local Gemma 4 model.

imageInput.label: Image Input
imageInput.description: Enable image (screenshot) input support. When active, you can send a screenshot alongside text prompts for the AI to see and describe your screen.

test.label: Test the Brain
test.description: Send a test question to the configured endpoint.
test.prompt: In one short sentence, confirm that you can hear me.

reasoning.label: Razonamiento / Pensamiento del modelo
reasoning.description: Habilita el razonamiento interno y la generación de pensamientos para los modelos compatibles (p. ej., Gemma 4 / DeepSeek). Si se desactiva, se suprime el pensamiento para respuestas más rápidas.

footer.portableUpdateMessage: Las instalaciones portátiles no se pueden actualizar automáticamente. Para actualizar: descarga el instalador NSIS más reciente desde GitHub Releases, instálalo en la misma carpeta y luego copia tu carpeta Data/ (ajustes, modelos, grabaciones) de la versión anterior a la nueva.
footer.portableUpdateBrowseMessage: Las instalaciones portátiles no se pueden actualizar automáticamente. Descarga la versión más reciente para tu sistema desde GitHub Releases e instálala en la misma carpeta: tu carpeta Data/ (ajustes, modelos, grabaciones) se conserva.

enabled.label: Multi-STT
enabled.description: Run multiple transcription models in parallel and merge the results.

models.title: Model Slots
models.model2Description: An optional second STT model to transcribe alongside the primary.
models.model3Description: An optional third STT model to transcribe alongside the primary and secondary.
models.languageNotApplicable: This model does not support language selection.

useLlama.label: Use llama.cpp for merge
useLlama.description: When enabled, the LLM merge uses the local llama.cpp server (Gemma 4) instead of a cloud provider.

brainMode.title: Brain Model Participation
brainMode.label: Brain model mode
brainMode.description: How the Brain model (Gemma 4) participates in the multi-STT pass.

options.separateAsr: Separate ASR + merge (audio transcribed in its own prompt)
options.audioInMerge: Audio in merge prompt (transcribe on the fly)

gemma4.title: Gemma 4 Multimodal STT
gemma4.label: Enable Gemma 4 2B STT
gemma4.description: Adds a 4th transcription source using Gemma 4 2B with mmproj and audio input via the llama.cpp server.

mergePrompt.title: Merge Prompt
mergePrompt.description: LLM prompt used to merge transcriptions from all models.
mergePrompt.promptPlaceholder: ${output}, ${output2}, ${output3} — merge these transcriptions into one accurate result...
mergePrompt.promptTip: Use ${output} for primary, ${output2} for secondary, ${output3} for tertiary.
mergePrompt.noPrompt: No merge prompt configured. Transcriptions will be concatenated as fallback.

status.title: Status
status.audioInMerge: Audio in merge prompt (Gemma 4 transcribes on the fly)

accessibility.permissionsDescription: Handy necesita permisos de accesibilidad para escribir texto transcrito.

micPermissionDenied.generic: El sistema operativo denegó el acceso al micrófono. Por favor, conceda el permiso del micrófono en la configuración del sistema.
micPermissionDenied.windows: Active el acceso al micrófono en Configuración → Privacidad y seguridad → Micrófono (incluido el acceso de aplicaciones de escritorio).
micPermissionDenied.macos: Conceda el acceso al micrófono en Ajustes del Sistema → Privacidad y seguridad → Micrófono.
micPermissionDenied.linux: Conceda el acceso al micrófono en la configuración de sonido o privacidad de su sistema.

errors.noInputDevice: No se detectó ningún dispositivo de entrada de audio. Conecta un micrófono o auriculares e inténtalo de nuevo.
errors.pasteFailed: No se pudo pegar el texto en la aplicación activa.

appLanguage.title: Idioma de la aplicación
appLanguage.description: Cambia el idioma de la interfaz de S2B2S

theme.title: Tema de la aplicación
theme.description: Elige si Handy sigue el tema del sistema o permanece claro u oscuro

secureInput.recorderBlockedWithCulprit: {{name}} puede estar bloqueando los cambios de atajos
secureInput.recorderBlockedNoCulprit: macOS está bloqueando temporalmente los cambios de atajos
secureInput.recorderBlocked: Ahora mismo no se pueden grabar atajos: Secure Input de macOS está bloqueando los eventos de teclado. Resuelve primero el aviso de Secure Input.

conversation.disabledHint: The Brain is disabled. Enable it in the Brain settings to start a conversation.
conversation.hotkeyHint: Hold {{hotkey}} and speak to ask by voice — the reply streams here and is read aloud.
conversation.empty: Ask something by voice or type below. This is the Speech → Brain → Speech loop.
conversation.inputPlaceholder: Type a message (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
conversation.brainOnlySttTooltip: Bypass STT models and use Brain AI for transcription
conversation.regionCaptureTooltip: Drag a screen region and ask the Brain about it (Windows)
conversation.regionDefaultQuestion: Describe what you see in the selected region of the screen.

logViewer.title: App Diagnostics & Logs
logViewer.noFilterMatch: No log entries match your filter criteria.
logViewer.clearConfirm: Are you sure you want to truncate the log files?

localGemma.title: Motor local Gemma 4 (Llama.cpp)
localGemma.brainDescription: Para ejecutar Brain localmente, S2B2S compila y ejecuta llama.cpp en su equipo. Es necesario descargar el modelo Gemma 4, el modelo borrador MTP y el proyector de visión (tamaño total {{size}}).
localGemma.postProcessDescription: To run post-processing locally, S2B2S compiles and executes llama.cpp on your machine. We need to download the specialized Gemma-4 UD-Q4_K_XL model, draft model for Multi-Token Prediction, and vision projector (total size ~2.2 GB).

mobileVariant.label: Mobile variant (lower VRAM)
mobileVariant.description: Use Google's mobile-optimized Gemma 4 E2B QAT checkpoint (only Q2_K_XL) to reduce VRAM usage further at some quality cost.

localGemma.quantCatalogError: Could not fetch quantization list from Hugging Face.

quickToggle.label: Modelo Gemma 4 4B (Calidad mejorada)
quickToggle.description: Cambie a Gemma 4 4B IT QAT para un razonamiento más profundo y mayor precisión.

mmprojToggle.label: Proyector multimodal (Sonido y Visión)
mmprojToggle.description: Carga el proyector visual y de audio. Desactívelo para modo solo texto y ahorre ~1 GB de VRAM.

mtpToggle.label: Aceleración especulativa MTP
mtpToggle.description: Habilita la aceleración de borrador multi-token para una generación 2x más rápida.

llamaCpp.serverDescription: Pre-compiled llama.cpp server binaries are downloaded from GitHub releases. Select a backend and download the server to enable local LLM inference.
llamaCpp.noReleases: No releases found. Check your internet connection.
